title: Dragon and Dripping Orbs
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a large red and orange dragon with fiery wings coiled through the sky, surrounded by numerous floating spheres with dripping paint effects. Below, two small human figures stand on a path amid swirling colorful clouds and a glowing yellow-orange background with autumnal trees.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a majestic red-orange dragon with flaming wings coiled through a swirling vortex of colorful clouds, surrounded by many floating spheres in red, blue, and purple with thick dripping paint effects. Two tiny human figures stand below on a path, vibrant autumn trees in the background, glowing yellow center, dynamic composition, painterly style with visible brush strokes.
